create_ScaleFactor_module: create a ScaleFactor nn.Module that scales input tensors by a learned scale factor parameter
fit_ScaleFactor_with_context: fit a ScaleFactor module using fit_context_ to compute variance ratio from observed tensor statistics
set_ScaleFactor_value: set the scale_factor parameter on a fitted ScaleFactor module to a specific float or tensor value
reset_ScaleFactor: reset a ScaleFactor module by zeroing its scale_factor parameter back to the unfitted state
forward_ScaleFactor_tensor: forward a tensor through a ScaleFactor module to apply scaling and optionally observe variance statistics
